# C1 Compacting Test: Five Sequential tool-help Calls
Folder: private
Description: Ran a mid-stream context-compacting test by issuing five sequential tool-help queries ('list', 'search', 'chat', 'image', 'audio') after a large filler context block. All five calls returned valid tool listings covering 591 total tools. The run completed successfully and reported C1_PASS.
